Look AI Ventures is a pre-Series A venture capital fund based in Prague, Czech Republic, investing in early-stage AI startups.

Look AI Ventures fund (LAIV) is the first investment fund in the Czech Republic that focuses exclusively on AI startups worldwide and provides new investors with the opportunity to seek the high returns that AI businesses promise.

investice.citace: Look AI Ventures has backed Embodied AI, a Lausanne-based robotics startup building robots that learn new tasks directly on factory production lines. The round was led by Faber VC, with participation from Techshop Capital, Kickfund, Plug and Play San Francisco, Excellis, and Vento.

Sodex Innovations, an Austrian construction tech startup developing AI-powered surveying technology for construction sites, mines, and infrastructure projects, has closed a funding round of €4 million. The round was led by Capmont Technology, with participation from Bloomhaus, Look AI Ventures, Superangels, SOSV, and 12 Rounds Capital.
Look AI Ventures has backed Lucida AI's $7M seed round, led by Velocity Capital, to scale its speech-to-speech AI platform for global communication.

Checkstep, the AI content moderation platform transforming Trust and Safety infrastructure for online platforms, raised £3 million in funding. The round was led by Alea Capital Partners, with participation from Slow Ventures and Look AI Ventures.

Surveily, a Wrocław-based edge AI company bringing real-time computer vision into industrial safety, has raised a €2.5 million Series A round. The round was led by Swiss industrial technology investor Momenta, with participation from our Look AI Ventures fund and other investors.
